messages.Désinstaller « {name} » et nettoyer ses:
Uninstall “{name}” and clean its leftovers?

The software will be removed, then its program files, recognized caches and technical traces will be checked automatically.

Cleanup will preserve profiles, settings and personal data. Uncertain or shared leftovers will be kept.

Removed files will go to the Recycle Bin; a report and registry backups will remain available.
